scientific_scope: paired whole-architecture proxy evidence only; no component attribution or architecture promotion

input_contract.checkpoint_retention: exactly one complete final checkpoint per run
integrity: seed and packed-data offset match the frozen pair
checkpoint and run-summary identities are retained
every loss and timing value is finite
source-loss keys are identical across all six runs

statistical_contract.primary_rule: the upper one-sided paired 95% Student-t bound must be at or below 0.01 nats and every source-loss upper bound must be at or below 0.02 nats
statistical_contract.multiplicity: one frozen whole-architecture candidate is tested; source guardrails form an intersection gate and are not separate discovery claims
statistical_contract.small_sample_limit: n=3 estimates paired variance for proxy screening only and has no promotion authority

fixed_analytic_flops.method: piecewise-linear interpolation in training tokens between the two enclosing frozen validation boundaries

fixed_steady_training_time.budget: minimum final steady_training_seconds across the two arms within each pair
fixed_steady_training_time.method: piecewise-linear interpolation in steady training seconds; compile/startup, validation, checkpoint, and orchestration time are excluded

time_to_quality.target: locked by the separate control-only procedure below
time_to_quality.method: first piecewise-linear downward crossing in steady training seconds
time_to_quality.censoring: if either arm does not reach the target, retain the pair as right-censored and do not form a complete-case confidence bound

time_to_quality_target.rule: maximum final validation loss across the three complete dense-control runs, rounded upward
workflow: collect and qualify all three dense-control result records
write and hash the target-lock artifact
only then create or inspect candidate result records
pass the immutable target-lock artifact to the final analysis
time_to_quality_target.reason: the target is guaranteed reachable by every control while candidate failures remain explicit right-censoring

stopping_rule.pair_abandonment: forbidden after seeing either arm's quality
allowed_interruptions: non-finite loss or gradient raised by the training runtime
stopping_rule.recovery: resume the same frozen cell from its latest valid checkpoint; if it cannot be resumed, retain the failed attempt, document root cause, and preregister any rerun rather than silently replacing it
stopping_rule.analysis_on_incomplete_sample: integrity report only; no paired confidence bound or proxy pass decision

decision_authority: The analysis may pass or fail the whole-architecture proxy quality screen and estimate paired variance. It cannot promote KDA, NoPE, GQA, the 3:1 mixer ratio, a systems claim, or the architecture, and it cannot authorize paper-scale training.
